ic_name: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (Display Serial Interface, MIPI Alliance)

spec_provided_observability.name: Header ECC syndrome
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Hamming-modified (24,8) ECC; single-bit-correct + 2-bit-detect over DI + WC of every Packet Header (Short and Long).

spec_provided_observability.name: Long Packet Checksum
spec_provided_observability.purpose: CRC-16 polynomial x^16+x^12+x^5+1, init 0xFFFF, LSB-first; payload coverage; mandatory transmit on host, optional check on peripheral.

spec_provided_observability.name: Acknowledge and Error Report
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 16-bit Error Report mask returned via Short Packet DT=0x02 from peripheral after BTA — see L17 / L15 for bit definitions.

spec_provided_observability.name: Acknowledge Trigger Message
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Single-byte LP trigger message 0x21 sent by peripheral when no errors stored and command was non-Read non-ECC-error.

spec_provided_observability.name: EoTp Short Packet (DT=0x08)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Robust end-of-HS-transmission marker; payload fixed 0x0F0F + ECC 0x01; detected regardless of HS or LP transmission mode.

spec_provided_observability.name: Sync Event Short Packets
spec_provided_observability.purpose: VSS/VSE/HSS/HSE Short Packets (DT=0x01/0x11/0x21/0x31) convey display-timing events to peripheral with byte-accurate timestamping.

spec_provided_observability.name: Set Maximum Return Packet Size (0x37)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Host bounds peripheral read-response packet length to prevent buffer overflow.

spec_provided_observability.name: BTA (Bus Turn-Around)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: LP Escape Mode-based explicit handover ensures bus ownership is unambiguous between host and peripheral.

spec_provided_observability.name: Tearing Effect (TE) trigger 0x5D
spec_provided_observability.purpose: LP Escape trigger message from Command Mode peripheral telling host when safe to write next frame (replaces the dedicated TE wire of parallel DBI-2).

error_detection_mechanisms: Hamming-modified header ECC: single-bit correct / 2-bit detect on every packet header.
Payload CRC-16 on Long Packets; checksum 0xFFFF for zero-length payload; checksum 0x0000 from non-checksum-capable peripheral.
Acknowledge and Error Report Short Packet (DT=0x02 in reverse direction) carries 16-bit error mask (Error Report bits 0..15).
HRX_TO / HTX_TO / LTX-P_TO / LRX-H_TO contention-recovery timers ensure bounded fault-recovery time.
Optional TA_TO (Turnaround Acknowledge Timeout) detects BTA that does not complete within bounded time.
Optional PR_TO (Peripheral Reset Timeout) ensures host waits long enough after Reset command before resuming normal operation.
LP-Contention detector (LP-CD on bidirectional Data Lane 0) per §7.2.1 + Annex A; recovery flows defined for both endpoints (Cases 1/2/3).

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: 1-bit header error corrected; Error Report bit 8 set.
2-bit header error; packet dropped; rest of transmission lost; Error Report bit 9 set.
Long-Packet payload checksum mismatch; Error Report bit 10 set.
Receiver got DT not defined / not implemented; loses packet boundary; Error Report bit 11 set.
Packet header VC field not recognized; Error Report bit 12 set.
WC of header does not match number of payload bytes received before EoT/EoTp; Error Report bit 13 set.
Expected EoTp not received, or expected BTA not received after Read Request; Error Report bit 15 set.
PHY-detected Start-of-Transmission corrupted; Error Report bit 0 set.
Sync pattern corrupted at HS Entry; Error Report bit 1 set.
EoT sequence corrupted; Error Report bit 2 set.
LP Escape entry command unrecognized; Error Report bit 3 set.
LP TX sync error; Error Report bit 4 set.
HRX_TO expired during HS RX; Error Report bit 5 set.
Unexpected control sequence detected; Error Report bit 6 set.
Command Mode peripheral sends 0x5D LP trigger after BTA; informs host it is safe to write next frame.
LP-CD asserts LP-High Fault or LP-Low Fault on bidirectional lane; Annex A recovery flow runs.

error_clearing_rule: Errors shall be accumulated by the peripheral during single or multiple transmissions and only cleared after they have been reported back to the host. Errors are transmitted as part of an Acknowledge and Error Report response after the host issues a BTA.
error_isolation_caveat: Since errors accumulate across multiple transmissions before the next BTA, the host may be unable to associate a particular error to the specific transmission causing it. If per-transmission error attribution is required, software shall send individual packets in separate transmissions, each followed by BTA.
notes: DSI v1.01.00 inherits ECC + Checksum integrity machinery from CSI-2 / D-PHY but adds a peripheral-to-host reverse channel for explicit error reporting, plus the EoTp Short Packet as a protocol-layer end-marker independent of D-PHY EoT. The Tearing Effect trigger 0x5D is a DSI-only addition over CSI-2 — it replaces the dedicated TE pin of parallel DBI-2 interfaces with an in-band LP escape signaling sequence.
